bio.text: Paul Nolley, a Roscoe resident, is the Democratic candidate for Illinois' 16th Congressional District in 2026, challenging Rep. Darin LaHood.

As of a May 2025 NPR Illinois report, he was executive director of Project First Rate, an organization advocating for union contractors and tradespeople, and had previously worked at community organizations including the YMCA, United Way and Habitat for Humanity.
He worked on State Sen. Steve Stadelman's 2012 campaign.
He grew up in Rockford and South Beloit.
